name: Wildpyre

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Medium form; wildpyre_large is the Large one.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The wildpyre passes through creatures and objects as though they were Difficult Terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Quenching Water
traits.summary: Any water hurts it as Holy Water would.
traits.text: Water of any kind works on the wildpyre as Holy Water: a thrown flask or jug of water, or water a spell makes, burns it with Radiant damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Blazing Rends, and Flame Bind if it has recharged.

actions.name: Blazing Rend
actions.summary: +7, 1d8+4 Necrotic plus 2d6 Fire; the target starts burning and, if no bigger than the wildpyre, falls Prone.
actions.text: Claws of ghost-flame: 8 (1d8 + 4) Necrotic and 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target starts burning, and a creature no larger than the wildpyre is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Flame Bind
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. One creature within 60 ft: DC 15 Dex save or Restrained (save again at the end of each of its turns; it can tear free on its turn by taking 1d12 Fire plus 1d12 Necrotic).
actions.text: Ropes of flame lash a creature the wildpyre can see within 60 feet, which makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or is Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, and on its own turn it may instead tear free, taking 6 (1d12) Fire and 6 (1d12) Necrotic damage.

summary: The ghost of an animal that died in fire, still made of the flames that took it: it claws, sets things burning and binds with ropes of fire. Water puts it out.
